raw_segments.text: Leance, O my brother, good gentlemen, the wrongs I have done thee stir afresh within
me, and these thy offices so rarely kind are as interpreters of my behind-hand slackness.
Welcome hither, as is the spring to the earth. And hath he too expaws this paragon to the
fearful usage, at least ungentle of the dreadful Neptune, to greet a man not worth her pains,
much less T.H. adventure of her person.
